reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachet that tears open with one hand, because I'm out all day and a bottle never makes it into my bag. The 'every batch lab-tested' QR is a nice extra, and if a creator's video hit my bad-sleep problem I'd tap the orange cart for one box.
objection: 30 foil packets a month is a lot of trash, and I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I worry this ends up as another one I stop taking.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller starter box, or a creator showing it actually helps with sleep, would make me more sure. Being told the sachets are recyclable would help too.
